_comment: Reference Solstone workloads used to translate raw tok/s benchmarks into practical task-time estimates. Each task has a 'presence' field: 'foreground' tasks block a human (chat, voice, interactive agents) — speed is UX-critical. 'background' tasks run autonomously (muse generators, indexers, describe pipeline) — total throughput matters more than individual-task latency. prompt_tokens/output_tokens mirror the actual sizes of think/benchmark/fixtures/<task>.txt — the canonical definition of each task. They drive the formula-based fallback; direct wall-clock measurements (see harness --task) always win when present in models.json. When production workloads diverge from fixture sizes (e.g., after pulling real journal content), rewrite the fixtures and re-run the harness.

chat_reply.label: Chat reply
chat_reply.description: One conversational turn from the Sol chat agent.

voice_brain_turn.label: Voice reply
voice_brain_turn.description: One voice-brain conversational turn. Users tolerate much less latency than text chat.

search_query.label: Search query
search_query.description: Journal search result synthesis / query rewriting.

agent_turn.label: Agent turn
agent_turn.description: One round of the cogitate briefing / research agent (pre-tool-call).

entity_extraction.label: Entity extraction
entity_extraction.description: Extract entities from one ~5-minute segment transcript.

todo_extraction.label: Todo extraction
todo_extraction.description: Extract actionable todos and commitments from a segment transcript.

meeting_summary.label: Meeting summary
meeting_summary.description: Synthesize a single meeting narrative from its transcript.

activity_clustering.label: Activity clustering
activity_clustering.description: Cluster observed events into higher-level activity narratives for the day.

daily_insight.label: Daily insights
daily_insight.description: Aggregate the day's events, transcripts, and muse outputs into a daily narrative.

audio_transcribe.label: Audio transcribe
audio_transcribe.description: Verbatim transcription of a 30s speech clip via a multimodal LLM. Comparable to Whisper/Parakeet ASR for speed; exercises the audio-input modality of omni models. Audio encoder ~380 tokens per 30s, text prompt adds ~25. (No current local provider accepts audio input — the bundled llama-server rejects it — so this task is unbenchmarked on the bundle.)

audio_summarize.label: Audio summarize
audio_summarize.description: Summarize a 30s speech clip in one paragraph via a multimodal LLM. Beyond what Whisper alone can do — measures end-to-end audio comprehension, not just transcription. Same fixture as audio_transcribe; differs in the text prompt and expected output length.

segment_sense.label: Segment sense
segment_sense.description: Lite per-segment classification: density, content_type, activity summary, entities, facets, speakers, emotional register. Runs once per segment (talent/sense.md).

speaker_attribution_llm.label: Speaker attribution (LLM)
speaker_attribution_llm.description: Layer 4 contextual fallback for speaker labelling — runs only when embedding-based layers fail and sense reports meeting_detected (talent/speaker_attribution.md).

screen_record.label: Screen record
screen_record.description: Chronological documentary record of a segment combining transcript and screen descriptions. Conditional on density=active (talent/screen.md).

awareness_tender.label: Awareness tender
awareness_tender.description: Per-segment housekeeping snapshot of identity / calendar / routines / recent entities (talent/awareness_tender.md). Talent caps output at 600 tokens.

pulse.label: Pulse
pulse.description: Per-segment narrative pulse + 'needs you' action items, drawing on calendar, todos, and recent entities (talent/pulse.md). Talent caps output at 1000 tokens.
